class MinStack:
    def __init__(self):
        self.stack = []
        self.min_stack = []

    def push(self, val: int) -> None:
        self.stack.append(val)
        if not self.min_stack or val <= self.min_stack[-1]:
            self.min_stack.append(val)

    def pop(self) -> None:
        if self.stack:
            val = self.stack.pop()
            if val == self.min_stack[-1]:
                self.min_stack.pop()

    def top(self) -> int:
        return self.stack[-1]

    def get_min(self) -> int:
        return self.min_stack[-1]


def run_tests():
    s = MinStack()
    s.push(1)
    s.push(2)
    assert s.get_min() == 1
    assert s.top() == 2
    s.pop()
    assert s.top() == 1
    assert s.get_min() == 1

    s = MinStack()
    s.push(3)
    s.push(1)
    s.push(2)
    assert s.get_min() == 1
    s.pop()
    assert s.get_min() == 1
    s.pop()
    assert s.get_min() == 3

    s = MinStack()
    s.push(5)
    s.push(3)
    s.push(3)
    assert s.get_min() == 3
    s.pop()
    assert s.get_min() == 3
    s.pop()
    assert s.get_min() == 5

    s = MinStack()
    s.push(-1)
    s.push(0)
    s.push(-2)
    assert s.get_min() == -2
    s.pop()
    assert s.get_min() == -1

    s = MinStack()
    s.push(1)
    assert s.get_min() == 1
    assert s.top() == 1
    s.pop()

    s = MinStack()
    for v in [2, 0, 3, 0]:
        s.push(v)
    assert s.get_min() == 0
    s.pop()
    assert s.get_min() == 0
    s.pop()
    assert s.get_min() == 0
    s.pop()
    assert s.get_min() == 2

    print("All tests passed.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_tests()
